title: Felix and the Will
author: Orsen Halloran
blurb: Xanthe Oyelaran, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
